probe.text_sample: Rhythm Dialogues Rhythm Dialogues Apply About About Get Involved RD – Artist Residency Open Call Instagram Rhythm Dialogues Rhythm Dialogues is an independently spirited exercise – exploring new horizons of meaning. Imagination is a place where it rains As Rhythm Dialogues evolves, stay informed about future programming by joining our mailing list below. First name Last name Email address * Thank you, please check your email Please fill out all required fields Rhythm Dialogues is a new platform for creative exchange. Working at the intersection of multiple art forms—dance, music, art, poetry, writing, philosophy, photography, film, design—it seeks to create space for individuals and artists to transcend creative boundaries through open-ended experimentation. A multi-faceted project, it includes a mobile artist-residency housed in a re-designed 1974 Airstream; annual “Convergences” that bring together some of the most celebrated artists, designers, writers, and thinkers to explore a broad range of topics; and its archival and publishing arm, 11:11 RD Editions.
